status: Partial human reconstruction of RH and unrestricted Dirichlet GRH, accepting the pinned formal proof as correct. Version 0.53 continues the detailed proof-note approach with 82 independently reviewed numbered claims, bringing the inventory to 3361. It completes the original algebraic Noetherian cube model, full FinPtOf and abstract propagation implications, full compatible-measure RescaleStep3, and both generic Wach-lattice constructors at their original scopes. No additional whole selected obligation is closed: 24 remain, comprising 17 class C and 7 class B, with 17 shared RH/GRH and 7 additional unrestricted Dirichlet-GRH obligations. Actual geometric section comparison, rank-specific arithmetic/automorphic producers, three period-ring suppliers and the later Wach comparison, and global transport/volume/counting/spectral producers remain explicit. GLOBAL_LOCAL_GAIN remains fully closed from v0.49. Counts are inventories, not completion percentages. No Lean replay or PDF is claimed.
local_conclusions: FCD1-FCD18 complete the original algebraic Noetherian section-cube model. Finite polynomial and matrix identities record both formal smoothness of the chart algebra and the projective splitting of its module. All their coefficients descend together to one finitely generated subring that works for every homogeneous chart. The chapter proves completion flatness through Artin-Rees and a formal-smooth retract, finite graded presentation up to chart-power torsion, and finite Cech cohomology by an explicit Laurent-monomial contraction and descending dimension shifting. Homogeneous localization, all restriction maps and arbitrary scalar extension give the original R0,C0,theta of exists_noetherian_model_grCube. Actual geometric sections and their localization/gluing comparison remain the next supplier; no global section-law closure is inferred.

ACP1-ACP19 complete the full original FinPtOf implication at every IsCD test ring and the original abstract propagation principles. For the actual diagonal-residual IsLiftA points, C=k+m_A is a complete Noetherian local coefficient ring with residue k; finite residue degree is supplied by IsCD. Matrices, inverse matrices and ordinary-character values lie in C, and its maximal-ideal powers give the required topology. Universality realizes the actual point without invoking the more general point_loc theorem. The off-triangular branch uses OffFin; the triangular branch uses the finite exponent and torsion-free principal units. The full flag, NicePrimeEx, local/global propagation and flat-chart implications are proved at their original scopes. Actual rank-specific geometry, OffFin, automorphic seeds and Alt arithmetic outputs remain.

GMR1-GMR19 complete the full original RescaleStep3 on the supplied setting. One standard character determines the self-dual measures. The Gram map is a submersion on all independent tuples, even over singular Gram parameters; chartwise coarea gives the full continuous fiber family and pointwise uniqueness. Exact finite-field frame counts give a_v=product_{j=n-a+1}^n(1-epsilon_v^j q_v^(-j)); a summable logarithmic bound proves a positive global normalization. The restricted product, actual unitary orbit, every-section quotient formula and exact S/S0 product produce both global and local stabilizer measures. AMD then preserves the original bridge and infinity measures while imposing all compatibilities simultaneously. Arithmetic quotient-volume identities, Forms0 and the all-family transport/counting/spectral producers remain separate.

WLD1-WLD26 complete the original generic Wach-lattice construction from one prismatic realization. Iterative p-adic coefficient lifting supplies the exact coefficient normal form. Both power-denominator inclusions give an invertible Frobenius matrix, and a square dr-coordinate argument plus a tensor normal form proves the actual base-change isomorphism without assuming flatness of a period extension. The local-prism value gives the same basis, both Frobenius inclusions and divisibility of the group difference. The original crystalline fullness transports every lattice map, and the trivial crystal fixes the prescribed generator. Taking one inverse image inside the supplied etale module gives every original WN field. The full generic build_prism retains its original hreal and direct hmem; the all-layer return retains precisely three stated period-ring suppliers and does not claim complete HW/Fon/Cmp.
remaining_major_inputs: GMR completes the full original global stabilizer-measure constructor, normalized local frame-stabilizer constructor and RescaleStep3. The proof constructs continuous Gram fiber families, proves uniqueness at every parameter including singular ones, computes exact good-place masses and proves a strictly positive convergent product. One standard character is fixed before all words, places and auxiliary tuples; the actual setting, supplied bridge and infinity measures are preserved. The original SiegelWeilUnitaryConvergent premise is retained; its arithmetic theta/quotient-volume identities are not claimed proved by the measure construction. BQS and the inherited chain already give full BesselNVGap. Forms0 and the all-family Witt/genus/level/intertwiner Transport/LevelMatch suppliers remain, as do Bessel uniqueness, local volume identities and product ties, AutTie/RowDictTie/LabTie, simultaneous arithmetic cylinder counts and the normalized GLOBAL_SPECTRAL estimate.

FCD supplies the full original all-chart homogeneous-matrix descent, finite graded presentation, finite graded Cech cohomology and exists_noetherian_model_grCube. One Noetherian R0, one cube C0 and the actual comparisons are chosen before every base change; the nonempty vertices are flat. GSL8 consumes this model. The remaining section-model suppliers are the actual twisted-section extension and power-killing/gluing results, actual dehomogenization and section-cube comparison, affine line-bundle finite projectivity and chart smoothness, on the fixed original scheme and bundles. Do not reopen the algebraic Noetherian-model theorem or retain it as an opaque assumption. The independent PolBaseChangeSt, Serre/multiplication/invariant descent, geometric integrality, principal rank one, torsion section decomposition/growth and theorem-of-square generators remain. Supply those original producers on the same polarized abelian scheme before GSL26 and the completed TDR/NFR/NFL uniformization. Moduli and HUF/PUN foundations remain explicit. Later finite-level systems, Gaussian/reproduction, simultaneous dictionaries, ramified jets, all-tuple class sums, phase-sensitive uniqueness, common PointIdentCore and base ClassSumsSpan remain, retaining both levels, whole fields, Fits and eta agreement.

ACP proves full FinPtOf at every original IsCD test ring from the supplied Space and literal OffFin, using the sufficient IsLiftA point realization through k+m_A. It also proves full flag_loc, o1, NicePrimeEx, LocProp, GlobProp, ChartOfFlat and GlobOfCharts. These abstract propagation and finite-point implications do not yet supply OffFin or the complete rank-two/rank-three propagation producers. Remaining arithmetic suppliers are the actual deformation charts and flatness, sharp component/dimension bounds, preconnected core and seed incidence, rank-two-to-three corner and exceptional ideal, and the actual automorphic seeds, patching/modularity and classicality outputs, and the original finPtDown descent from the extended coefficient frame before returning to the original FinEnd consumer. Keep separate rank-two/rank-three rings and ideals on the same AFE marked frame, with original P retained where used. The actual terminal route uses stronger GdEndAlt/HostEndAlt including WitA/WitAQ; ACP19 proves only their projection to the original endpoints. AFE full Gen/Host entries, common-frame joins, NRep descent and FinPt-to-FinEnd remain available, including Host ell=3; UCE supplies the original GdEnd consumer.

WLD completes the full original adic-coordinate, denominator-matrix, base-change lattice, restricted-projectivity and local-prism value producers, and both generic WachLattice.build/build_prism implications. The actual lattice is the inverse image of one prismatic image inside the supplied etale module; its original Frobenius, group action, trivial-line and all lattice-map fields are proved together. Full all-layer WachEx still needs the actual Wach prism, ioE injectivity/unit reflection and homogeneous cyclotomic-kernel-fixed Frobenius matrix descent at the original scopes. After those, faithful invariants, etale bases, Herr class maps and quantitative comparison still supply the complete HW/Fon/Cmp triple. No additional inter-layer transition system is required by the original Layers assembly. SSC already supplies the full Selmer SignatureChoice and DFD12 the exact Bhatt-Scholze coefficient conversion. Then prove every original local row/table bound on one common family for ConclF, retaining ShaFinOdd, exceptional sets, vvTerm summability and uniform thresholds. DNE supplies ConclF-to-AdmF-to-LinkN with K=2000(|Ca|+1)^3 fixed before the family; GLOBAL_DENOMINATOR remains open.
